# GREEN

> GREEN is an open-source suite for Green's-function-based electronic-structure and many-body calculations, including input preparation, HF/GF2/GW and embedding workflows, analytic continuation, and post-processing.

## Start here

- [GREEN documentation](https://green-phys.org/docs/): Main user-documentation router.
- [Getting started](https://green-phys.org/docs/getting-started/): End-to-end path from input preparation through a GREEN calculation and post-processing.
- [Source installation](https://green-phys.org/docs/installation/from_sources/): Current release selection, prerequisites, CPU/GPU builds, tests, and installation.
- [Troubleshooting](https://green-phys.org/docs/troubleshoot/): Common installation and runtime failures with remedies.

## Run a calculation

- [Prepare input](https://green-phys.org/docs/getting-started/preparing_input/): Generate supported mean-field data, integrals, symmetry metadata, and input files with green-mbtools.
- [Run GREEN](https://green-phys.org/docs/getting-started/running_greens/): Invoke green-mbpt for documented HF, GF2, and GW workflows.
- [Examples](https://green-phys.org/docs/getting-started/examples/): Maintained calculation examples.
- [Post-processing](https://green-phys.org/docs/getting-started/postprocessing/): Analyze GREEN output with supported tools.
- [SEET impurity solver](https://green-phys.org/docs/installation/seet_solver/): Build and connect the documented embedding solver stack.

## Data contracts

- [HDF5 data formats](https://green-phys.org/docs/components/data-formats/): Shared dimensions, notation, and versioning for GREEN 1.x files.
- [Input file](https://green-phys.org/docs/components/data-formats/input-file/): Versioned input.h5 datasets, shapes, types, and meanings.
- [Output files](https://green-phys.org/docs/components/data-formats/output-files/): Versioned result and high-symmetry output datasets, restart markers, and caveats.

## Scientific and developer references

- [Citation authority](https://github.com/Green-Phys/green-citations): Canonical bibliographic metadata and component, version, and method citation policy.
- [Generated citation guidance](https://github.com/Green-Phys/green-citations/blob/main/CITATION.md): Human-readable output generated from the canonical metadata and policy.
- [Papers and citations](https://green-phys.org/docs/publications/): Website presentation generated from the independent citation authority.
- [Acknowledgment](https://green-phys.org/docs/acknowledgment/): Copyable software acknowledgment and citation guidance.
- [GREEN BibTeX](https://green-phys.org/data/green-references.bib): Generated machine-readable records mirrored from the independent citation authority.
- [Theory](https://green-phys.org/docs/theory/): Scientific background for Green's functions, HF, GF2, GW, embedding, grids, and thermodynamics.
- [Components](https://green-phys.org/docs/components/): Core libraries and many-body framework components.
- [Contribution policy](https://green-phys.org/docs/contribution/): C++ conventions, testing, documentation, and community expectations.
- [Developer notes](https://green-phys.org/docs/developers/): Developer-oriented Green project information.

## Agent skill

- [green-mbpt-run skill](https://github.com/Green-Phys/green-mbpt/blob/main/.agents/skills/green-mbpt-run/SKILL.md): Machine-readable guidance for selecting compatible components, preparing inputs, running calculations, locating outputs, and avoiding unsupported scientific assumptions.
